Memo visibility is enforced in many places across this Memos codebase — not only in one central helper. Below are the distinct enforcement sites that gate **viewing** memo content (or memo-derived data), grouped by server surface.

---

## 1. Memo RPC API — single-memo read gate

**Site:** `checkMemoReadAccess` (central read-authorization helper)  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`  
**Function/lines:** `checkMemoReadAccess` **39–67** — archived memos hidden from non-creators (45–52); non-`PUBLIC` requires auth (55–62); `PRIVATE` denied unless creator (63–64).

**Call sites:**
- `GetMemo` **356–368** (also checks parent memo)
- `ListMemoComments` **148–149** (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`)

---

## 2. Memo RPC API — list/query filtering

**Site:** `ListMemos` visibility scoping  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`  
**Function/lines:** `ListMemos` **218–226** — anonymous → `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]`; authenticated viewing another user → filter `creator_id == … || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` or `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC, PROTECTED]`.

---

## 3. Memo RPC API — comments listing (parent + comment filter)

**Site:** `ListMemoComments`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`  
**Function/lines:**
- Parent memo gate: `checkMemoReadAccess` **148–149**
- Comment memo filter: **156–160** (`visibility == "PUBLIC"` or creator/PROTECTED filter), applied via `MemoFilter` at **178**

---

## 4. Memo RPC API — relations visibility filter

**Site:** `ListMemoRelations`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`  
**Function/lines:** **107–112** builds `memoFilter`; **116, 130** pass it to `Store.ListMemoRelations` so related memos are visibility-filtered.

**Also:** `batchConvertMemoRelations` in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go` **182–205** — same filter pattern when embedding relations in `GetMemo`/`ListMemos` responses.

---

## 5. Memo RPC API — attachments on memos

**Site A:** `ListMemoAttachments` inline check  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go`  
**Function/lines:** **213–224** — non-`PUBLIC` requires auth; `PRIVATE` denied unless creator/admin.

**Site B:** `checkAttachmentAccess` (linked attachment → memo visibility)  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`  
**Function/lines:** `checkAttachmentAccess` **422–454**; enforced in `GetAttachment` at **256**.

---

## 6. Memo RPC API — reactions (view memo reactions)

**Site:** `ListMemoReactions` / `UpsertMemoReaction`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`  
**Function/lines:**
- `ListMemoReactions` **29–40** — same PUBLIC/PROTECTED/PRIVATE rules
- `UpsertMemoReaction` **82–84** — blocks reactions on others’ `PRIVATE` memos

---

## 7. Memo RPC API — share-token view path

**Site:** `GetMemoByShare`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go`  
**Function/lines:** `GetMemoByShare` **153–166** — resolves via `getActiveMemoShare` (**199–206**); rejects invalid/expired tokens and archived memos (returns `NOT_FOUND`).

---

## 8. User stats RPC API — aggregated memo visibility

**Site:** `ListAllUserStats` / `GetUserStats`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go`  
**Function/lines:**
- `ListAllUserStats` **77–91** — archived creator-only; anonymous → `PUBLIC` only; others → PROTECTED filter
- `GetUserStats` **217–220** — anonymous → `PUBLIC`; other user → `[PUBLIC, PROTECTED]`

---

## 9. User notifications RPC API — memo payload redaction

**Site:** `canViewerAccessMemo` + notification converters  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`  
**Function/lines:**
- `canViewerAccessMemo` **302–315** — PRIVATE → creator; PROTECTED → authenticated; PUBLIC → all
- Applied in `convertMemoCommentNotificationPayload` **337–342** and `convertMemoMentionNotificationPayload` **370, 385**

---

## 10. SSE live feed — per-client event delivery filter

**Site:** `SSEClient.canReceive`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`  
**Function/lines:** `canReceive` **134–143** — `PRIVATE` events only to creator or admin; `PUBLIC`/`PROTECTED` broadcast to all connected clients. Called from `Broadcast` **123**.

*(Subscription itself requires auth in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go` **37–44**.)*

---

## 11. HTTP file/resource server — attachment binary access

**Site:** `checkAttachmentPermission`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`  
**Function/lines:** `checkAttachmentPermission` **650–703** — public memo + anonymous instance (677–678); share-token fallback (684–688); auth required otherwise (695–696); `PRIVATE` forbidden unless creator/admin (699–700). Enforced in `serveAttachmentFile` **149**.

---

## 12. RSS feed — public memos only

**Site:** `GetExploreRSS` / `GetUserRSS`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go`  
**Function/lines:**
- `GetExploreRSS` **88–90** — `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]`
- `GetUserRSS` **138–141** — same filter scoped to user

---

## 13. Frontend SEO/sitemap — public memos only

**Site:** `getSitemapXML`  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go`  
**Function/lines:** **149–150** — `ListMemos` with `VisibilityList: [PUBLIC]`

---

## 14. Email notifications — memo link/snippet gating

**Site:** `canViewerAccessMemo` in email dispatcher  
**File:** `/bench/repo/server/notification/email.go`  
**Function/lines:**
- `canViewerAccessMemo` **306–319**
- Comment emails **155**; mention emails **187**

---

## 15. Store/query layer — SQL visibility enforcement (when callers set filters)

These apply visibility at the DB query level when upper layers pass `VisibilityList`, `Filters`, or `MemoFilter`:

| Site | File | Lines |
|------|------|-------|
| `ListMemos` `VisibilityList` SQL | `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go` | **89–95** |
| Same (SQLite) | `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go` | **96–102** |
| Same (MySQL) | `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go` | **104+** |
| `ListMemoRelations` `MemoFilter` subquery | `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go` | **82–108** |
| Same (SQLite) | `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go` | **80–93** |

Filter strings like `visibility == "PUBLIC"` and `creator_id == … \|\| visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` are compiled via `/bench/repo/internal/filter` and appended to SQL by `filter.AppendConditions` / `CompileToStatement`.

---

## Summary

There are **at least 14 distinct server surfaces** (plus 3 DB dialect implementations) enforcing memo view visibility:

| Surface | Primary mechanism |
|---------|-------------------|
| Memo gRPC/Connect RPC (`GetMemo`, lists, relations, attachments, reactions) | `checkMemoReadAccess`, inline checks, query filters |
| Share RPC | Valid share token |
| User stats/notifications RPC | `VisibilityList` / `canViewerAccessMemo` |
| SSE HTTP | `canReceive` per-event filter |
| File server HTTP | `checkAttachmentPermission` |
| RSS / Sitemap HTTP | `VisibilityList: PUBLIC` only |
| Email | `canViewerAccessMemo` |
| Store SQL | `VisibilityList` / `MemoFilter` WHERE clauses |

MCP (`/bench/repo/server/router/mcp/service.go`) proxies in-process API routes and does **not** add a separate visibility layer — enforcement happens in the underlying handlers above.
